description: NaSmSe₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.94 Å. Sm is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-3.08 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.74 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.67 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sm and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Sm and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sm, and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Sm and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sm, and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Se atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one Se atom.
